plugin.title: Jellystics plugin
plugin.hint: Records every playback on the Jellyfin server itself: the most precise source of statistics.
plugin.unhealthyHint: The plugin has not synced for more than 2 minutes: the Jellystics tracker records plays in the meantime.

push.title: Save the history to the plugin
push.hint: Sends the plays Jellystics recorded itself (tracker, imports) to the plugin, so its database holds your whole history. Safe to run again: plays already present are skipped.
push.start: Save the history to the plugin
push.done: Last save: {{sent}} / {{total}} plays sent; {{imported}} added, {{skipped}} already present, {{rejected}} rejected.
push.failed: Save stopped: {{error}}. It resumes where it stopped.
push.interrupted: Save interrupted by a restart of Jellystics. It resumes where it stopped.
push.doneNoCounts: Last save: {{sent}} / {{total}} plays sent (the plugin did not report what it added).

resync.title: Resync from the plugin
resync.hint: Re-reads every play and event recorded by the plugin, for instance after restoring a backup.
resync.confirmText: Jellystics will re-read everything the plugin recorded. Nothing is lost: plays already synced are updated, and a play recorded twice (by the tracker or an import and by the plugin) is replaced by the plugin version.

absent.lead: Install the Jellystics plugin on your Jellyfin server for exact statistics:
absent.b1: Exact watch time from Jellyfin playback events (pauses, seeks, skipped time) instead of polling every 5 seconds.
absent.b2: Nothing missed while Jellystics is stopped or restarting: plays are recorded on the server.
absent.b3: Audio and subtitle changes, transcode details, real library additions, logins and manual played marks.
absent.steps: In Jellyfin: Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories, add this URL, then install « Jellystics » from the catalog and restart Jellyfin.
